info.title: spezado
info.description: The open API of spezado: free accounting for everyone.

get.summary: The adapter that submits filings in a country, if one is set; never its token.

put.summary: Sets the adapter that submits filings in a country: its address and the token spezado authenticates itself with.

get.summary: The books of the workspace.

post.summary: Sets up books for a person.

get.summary: The accounts to book on, by national number.
The fixed assets of the owner, with their book values at a day.

post.summary: Registers a fixed asset.
Records that a fixed asset left the business and books its book value out.

get.summary: The balances of the accounts at the end of a year, those that have one.

post.summary: Books every open entry that has a proposal, all or none.

get.summary: The entries of bank statements not booked yet, each with a proposal where there is one.

post.summary: Books an entry by its proposal.
Books an entry on an account with a tax code, its amount as the gross amount.
Fetches statements from the bank by FinTS – waits for the product registration of falkOSS, answers 501 until then.
Reads a file of statements – camt.053, MT940 or a bank's CSV file – and records each statement.

parameters.name: iban
parameters.description: The IBAN of the account, for a CSV file that does not name it.

post.summary: Books lines that balance.
Books a gross amount on an account, split by its tax code, against the bank or the cash.
Closes the books of their owner up to a date.

get.summary: The customers and suppliers of the owner, by name.

post.summary:
Keeps a customer or supplier – new without an identity, else replacing the one with it – with its contact persons
and its relation to the owner.

get.summary: The Beitragsnachweis of the owner to one insurer: the contributions by the groups of the record, in euros.

parameters.name: insurer
parameters.description: The company number of the insurer.

get.summary: The customers, by name.

post.summary: Keeps a customer – new without an identity, else replacing the one with it.

get.summary:
The facts that move the owner's deadlines today: the state whose public holidays apply and whether VAT returns
are extended for good.

put.summary: Changes the facts that move the owner's deadlines from a date on; everything else stays as configured.

post.summary: Books the owner's depreciation of a calendar year, once; answers whether there was anything to book.

get.summary: The documents recorded, newest first.

post.summary:
Reads a file – an e-invoice (XRechnung, ZUGFeRD), a PDF, a photo – as a document, with a proposal for an e-invoice.
Nothing is recorded until it is named in `documents/pending/{pending}` within the hour.

parameters.name: payment
parameters.description: `bank` (default) or `cash`: where it was paid from or to.

post.summary: Records a document read – alone, or with its proposal, dated and worded as given.

Names the contact the other party of a recorded invoice is, or none – a correction of the document; its original
stays.

get.summary: The original of a document, byte for byte.
The employments of the owner as described today.

post.summary: Adds an employment under German law; the employee is described as a person by name. Returns its identity.

get.summary:
The Lohnsteuerbescheinigung of an employment for a year: its numbered lines in euros (names `de-lstb/<line>`);
empty for wages taxed at a flat rate or a year without payslips.
The filings of the books, in the order they were prepared.

post.summary:
Prepares the filing of a report for a period from the books as they are – the same filing again if one with
that content waits to be submitted, a correction if one was submitted.
Asks the adapter where a submitted filing stands and records an answer.

Submits a prepared filing through the adapter of its country. A test submission is not processed by the
authority and changes nothing in the books.

get.summary: The data transfer of the GoBD (Z3) for a period, as a ZIP file: `index.xml` and its CSV files.
What the owner stated for income tax of a year beside the books (shown in the report de-est).

put.summary: Stores what the owner states for income tax of a year – on this device, not in the books' events.

post.summary: Writes an invoice as XRechnung and records it; with double entry, its receivable is booked.

get.summary: The number the next invoice of a year gets.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: The calendar year; this one when none.

get.summary: The seller's details on invoices; null before they are given.

put.summary: Keeps the seller's details on invoices.

get.summary: The bookings of a year, by date.
The first day of the books and the opening balances booked.

post.summary: Books opening balances, once, against the opening balance sheet – they count in balances, in no result.

get.summary: The books at a glance, for a year.

post.summary: Computes the payslip of an employment for a month; with `record` records it and books it.

get.summary: What the owner stated for the taxes on profit of a year beside the books (shown in de-kst, de-gewst, de-est).

put.summary: Stores what the owner states for the taxes on profit of a year – on this device, not in the books' events.

post.summary: Reopens the latest closing of the owner of the books: the period it closed is open again; nothing is deleted.

get.summary:
The reports of a year: the advance VAT returns and the recapitulative statements with something in them, with their
deadlines; the annual ones.
The figures of a report for a period – a draft until tax advisers have reviewed its mapping.

post.summary: Reverses a booking.

get.summary: What needs review, each issue in a sentence of the language asked for.
Whether the books are synchronised, and through which relay.

post.summary: Synchronises the books now: adds devices that asked with an invitation, receives and sends.

get.summary: The devices of the books, as their relay lists them.

delete.summary: Removes a device or person from the books, by identity, device name or name; the key changes.

post.summary:
An invitation for another device, good for a day: the person's own (`manage`), or someone else's with the
rights given.
Starts synchronising the books through a relay; answers with the recovery code, shown this once.

get.summary: The tax codes to choose from.
The trade tax multiplier of the owner's municipality today.

put.summary: Changes the trade tax multiplier from a date on; everything else stays as configured.

get.summary: The devices paired.

Server-Sent Events: `changed` with the books whenever something was written – read again what is shown. A browser
passes its token as the query `token`.

post.summary: Pairs a device with the code `spezado serve` shows; returns its token, once.

get.summary: The states whose public holidays can move deadlines.

post.summary: Asks to join books with an invitation from another device; they arrive once that device has synchronised.
Brings books back to this device with their recovery code.

tax.description: The tax code postings on it carry, where it has one – an automatic account of DATEV.

url.description: Its address, if one is set.

value.description: The amount with a decimal point, as many places as the currency has: `"-12.40"`.

AssetDisposal.description: A fixed asset leaving the business.

proceeds.description: What it was sold for, without VAT, with a decimal point; absent when not sold.

AssetView.description: A fixed asset as the register shows it.

account.description: The account it is kept on: its national number.

book_value.description: The book value at the day asked for.

disposed.description: `YYYY-MM-DD`: the day it left, if it did.

months.description: The useful life in months, on a straight line.

BookEntry.description: Booking an entry on an account, its amount as the gross amount.

account.description: The account: national number or identity.

entry.description: The entry's position in it, from 1.

BooksRef.description: A set of books, by identity.

BooksSummary.description: A set of books of the workspace.

Close.description: Closing the books up to a date.

Contact.description: A customer or a supplier of the owner, or both.

id.description: Its identity; empty for a new one.

number.description: The owner's number for it; a new one gets the next free one when left out.

reference.description: What it asks to be named on invoices – a Leitweg-ID.

ContactPerson.description: Whom to contact at a customer or a supplier.

id.description: Their identity; empty for a new one.

ContactSuggestion.description: A contact the other party of a document may be.

email.description: Where invoices are sent: an e-mail address.

id.description: Its identity; empty for a new one.

reference.description: The reference the customer asked for – a Leitweg-ID; the invoice number when none.

vat_id.description: The VAT identification number, if there is one.

Deadlines.description: The facts that move an owner's deadlines.

from.description: From when they apply, `YYYY-MM-DD`: when changing, today if none.

region.description: The state whose public holidays move deadlines, ISO 3166-2 (`DE-BY`); none for holidays of all states only.

vat_extended.description: Whether advance VAT returns are due a month later for good (§ 46 UStDV).

DepreciationYear.description: The year whose depreciation to book.

Device.description: A device paired with the API.

DocumentContact.description: The contact the other party of an invoice is.

contact.description: A contact's identity; null for none.

DocumentView.description: A document recorded, or read and waiting to be recorded.

booked.description: Whether a booking rests on it.

contact.description: The identity of the contact the other party is, once known.

oneOf.description: The amount due, for an invoice.

media_type.description: The media type of its original.

name.description: The file name it came with.

number.description: Its number, e.g. the invoice number.

party_name.description: For an invoice: the other party as the invoice names it – the buyer of one an owner wrote, else the seller.

size.description: The size of its original in bytes.

EmploymentView.description: An employment as a list shows it (librotenado spec part 0013).

class.description: The tax class; none with the flat tax.

contribution_group.description: The key of the contribution groups.

employee.description: The employee, a person of the books.

end.description: The last day, if it ends.

insurer.description: The company number of the health insurer.

number.description: The employer's number for the employee.

person_group.description: The key of the group of persons.

EntryRef.description: An entry of a bank statement.

entry.description: The entry's position in it, from 1.

Figures.description: The figures of a report – a draft until tax advisers have reviewed its mapping.

law.description: The law module it was derived with, `name/version`.

reconciliation.description: For a balance sheet: how the tax balance sheet differs per position (Überleitungsrechnung).

terms.description: For a balance sheet: the remaining terms of the positions (§ 268 Abs. 4 and 5 HGB).

FilingView.description: A filing of the books and where it stands.

documents.description: The documents of what the authority returned.

from.description: The first day of its period.

outdated.description: The books changed since it was prepared so that its content would differ now.

to.description: The last day of its period.

Imported.description: What reading a file of statements did.

shown_before.description: Entries an earlier statement showed already.

IncomeTaxFacts.description: What a person states for income tax of a year beside the books.

capital_income.description: Capital income not taxed at source (§ 32d EStG).

child_allowances.description: The allowances for children in tenths: 10 a child in full, 5 half of one.

child_benefit.description: The child benefit received for the year.

church_rate.description: The rate of church tax in percent, 8 or 9; none without.

extraordinary.description: Extraordinary income taxed by the fifth (§ 34 EStG).

losses.description: Losses carried forward, not yet used.

other_income.description: Other positive income, with a decimal point.

partnership_income.description: Shares of profits of partnerships, and their trade tax base amounts and trade tax (§ 35 Abs. 2 EStG).

partnership_trade_base.description: The share of the trade tax base amounts of those partnerships.

partnership_trade_tax.description: The share of their trade tax.

single_parent_children.description: Children of a single parent (§ 24b EStG); 0 for none.

InvoiceLineInput.description: A line of a new invoice.

price.description: The net price of one unit, with a decimal point.

quantity.description: How much, with a decimal point: `2.5`.

tax.description:
`de-out-19`, `de-out-7`, `de-out-0`, `de-out-exempt`, `de-out-13b`, `de-out-eu-service`, `de-out-ig-supply`
or `de-out-export`; none for a small business.

unit.description: The unit, UN/ECE Recommendation 20: `HUR` hour, `DAY` day, `C62` piece.

payment_days.description: The days until payment is due.

tax_number.description: The tax number at the tax office.

vat_id.description: The VAT identification number, if there is one.

document.description: The document, whose original is the XRechnung or the ZUGFeRD PDF.

name.description: The file name of its original: `RE-2026-001.xml`, `RE-2026-001.pdf`.

JournalEntry.description: A booking as the journal shows it.

amount.description: What moved: the sum of its debits.

reverses.description: For a reversal, the event it reverses.

Line.description: A line of a booking to write.

account.description: The account: its national number or identity.

amount.description: Debit positive, credit negative, with a decimal point.

basis.description:
`commercial` or `tax` for a booking that counts in that balance sheet only – where the tax balance sheet
departs from the commercial one; absent for both.

account.description: The account of fixed assets: its national number or identity.

cost.description: Its cost without deductible VAT, with a decimal point.

months.description: The useful life in months, for `straight_line`.

NewEmployment.description: A new employment under German law; the employee is described as a person by name.

active_pension.description: Work after the standard retirement age with pension contributions of the employer (Aktivrente).

additional_rate.description: The insurer's additional rate in percent, e.g. `"2.9"`.

care_children.description: The children under 25 the care insurance counts.

childless.description: The employee pays the care surcharge for having no children.

children.description: The number of child allowances, e.g. `"1.5"`.

church.description: The religious community that levies church tax: `ev`, `rk`, …

class.description: The tax class, 1 to 6; none with `flat`.

contribution_group.description: The key of the contribution groups; default `1111`.

end.description: The last day, if it ends.

flat.description: Taxed at the flat rate of 2 % (minor employment).

household.description: A minor employment in a private household.

insurer.description: The company number of the health insurer – for a minor employment the Minijob-Zentrale.

number.description: The employer's number for the employee.

pension_start_monthly.description: For pensions paid: the pension of the first whole month.

pension_start_year.description: For pensions paid: the year they began.

person_group.description: The key of the group of persons; default `101`.

short_term.description: Taxed at the flat rate of 25 % (short-term employment, person group 110).

u1.description: The rate of the levy U1 in percent.

u2.description: The rate of the levy U2 in percent.

delivery.description: When the supply was made, `YYYY-MM-DD`; the invoice date when none.

exemption.description: Why exempt lines (`de-out-exempt`) are exempt; a general statement when none.

format.description: `xrechnung` – XML – or `zugferd` – a PDF with the XRechnung attached; `xrechnung` when none.

NextNumber.description: The number the next invoice gets.

OpenEntry.description: An entry of a bank statement not booked yet.

amount.description: Positive money in, negative money out.

entry.description: The entry's position in it, from 1.

text.description: The other party and the purpose.

Opening.description: Opening balances to book, once, against the opening balance sheet.

date.description: `YYYY-MM-DD`; the first day of the books when none.

text.description: The text of the booking; "Anfangsbestände" when none.

number.description: Its national number, if it has one.

account.description: The account: its national number or identity.

amount.description: What it held on the first day, with a decimal point: holdings positive, debts negative.

OpeningView.description: The opening balances of the books.

start.description: The first day of the books, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

oneOf.description: The next advance VAT return from today.

open_entries.description: Entries of bank statements not booked yet.

PairRequest.description: Exchanging a pairing code for a token.

name.description: What the device is called, to recognise it later: `"Laptop browser"`.

Paired.description: A token for a device, to send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

device.description: The device's identity, to revoke it.

token.description: The token; shown once, stored only as its hash.

amount.description: Its amount in euros, with a decimal point.

PayslipRequest.description: The payslip of an employment for a month, to compute or to record.

corrects.description:
The payslip this one corrects (Rückrechnung): its employment and month are taken; `employment` and `month`
are then ignored.

items.description: What the wages are made of.

paid.description: For a correction, the day the difference is paid, `YYYY-MM-DD`; default today.

record.description: Records the payslip and books it; otherwise it is only computed.

figures.description: The figures by name (librotenado spec part 0013), in euros.

from.description: The first day of its period.

items.description: What the wages are made of.

recorded.description: Whether it was recorded and booked.

replaces.description: The payslip it corrects, if it is a correction.

PrepareFiling.description: Preparing the filing of a report.

from.description: The first day of the period, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

to.description: The last day of the period, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

Problem.description: An error: what was refused or went wrong.

ProfitTaxFacts.description: What the books do not hold of the taxes on profit of a year (librotenado spec part 0012).

group.description: The part in a tax group: `member` or `parent`; none outside one.

group_compensation.description: For a member: the compensation paid to outside shareholders.

group_income.description: For a parent: the income attributed from the members.

group_trade_income.description: For a parent: their trade income.

income_losses.description: Losses carried forward for corporation or income tax, in euros.

interest_carryforward.description: Interest carried forward by the interest barrier.

interest_exception.description: An exception of the interest barrier applies (§ 4h Abs. 2 EStG).

land_reduction.description: The reduction for land (§ 9 Nr. 1 GewStG).

turnover_and_wages.description: Turnover and wages of the year, for the cap of donations; none if not stated.

ReadDocument.description: A file read as a document: waiting to be recorded, with a proposal if it is an e-invoice.

contacts.description: The contacts the other party of an e-invoice may be, the most certain first; the first is named already.

oneOf.description: The other party as a new contact, kept when `contact` is `new` on recording.

not_an_invoice.description: Why an XML file was not read as an e-invoice.

pending.description: What to name when recording it, within the hour.

oneOf.description: The booking proposed from an e-invoice.

Record.description: Recording a document read: alone, or with its proposal – dated and worded as given.

book.description: Whether to book the proposal with it.

contact.description:
The contact of the other party of an e-invoice: a contact's identity, `new` to keep the new contact, empty
for none; left out, the first suggestion stays.

date.description: The booking's date, `YYYY-MM-DD` – on a cash basis the day paid.

RecoveryCode.description: The recovery code of books, shown once.

RegionView.description: A state whose public holidays move deadlines.

name.description: Its name in the language asked for.

due.description: When an advance VAT return is due.

from.description: The first day of its period.

to.description: The last day of its period.

event.description: The event that recorded the booking.

SetAdapter.description: Setting the adapter of a country.

token.description: The token spezado authenticates itself with.

url.description: Its address: `https://…`, or `http://127.0.0.1:…` on this device.

SetUp.description: Setting up books for a person.

region.description: The state whose public holidays move deadlines, ISO 3166-2 (`DE-BY`); none when not given.

vat_extended.description: Whether the deadlines of advance returns are extended for good (§ 46 UStDV).

SimpleBooking.description: A booking from a gross amount.

account.description: The account: its national number or identity.

attributed.description:
`YYYY-MM-DD`: the day it counts on where profit is determined by receipts and payments, if not its date – a
regularly recurring payment within ten days of the turn of the year (§ 11 EStG).

documents.description: The documents it rests on: identities of documents recorded.

gross.description: The gross amount, VAT included, with a decimal point; negative for a refund.

tax.description: The tax code; none for what VAT does not touch.

message.description: How the authority explained a rejection.

receipts.description: The file names of what the authority returned.

test.description: Whether it was a test submission.
A test submission the authority does not process; nothing is recorded.

source.description:
`booked` – the payment booked before the statement came, booked again naming the entry –, `invoice` – an
unbooked invoice it pays – or `history` – as the same party's last entry.

device.description: The device name it writes under; none for the recovery code.

id.description: Its identity, to remove it by.

recovery.description: Whether it is the recovery code.

SyncInvitation.description: An invitation for another device, good for a day.

invitation.description: The text to carry to the other device.

SyncInvite.description: What an invited device may do.

rights.description: `read`, `write` or `manage` – the person's own devices; `manage` when none.

until.description: The last day the device may read and write – an auditor's –; unlimited when absent.

invitation.description: The invitation from the other device.

SyncRecover.description: Recovering books with their recovery code.

waiting.description: Whether this device still waits to be added.

relay.description: The relay they are synchronised through; none when they are not.

TaxCodeView.description: A tax code to choose from.

Terms.description: The remaining terms of a position of the balance sheet.

over_five_years.description: Due after more than five years.

over_one_year.description: Due after more than a year – those after five included.

unknown.description: On accounts without a remaining term: to be divided by whoever draws up the balance sheet.

TradeTax.description: The trade tax multiplier of the owner's municipality.

from.description: From when it applies, `YYYY-MM-DD`: when changing, today if none.

multiplier.description: The multiplier in percent, at least 200; none when the owner is not subject to trade tax.

VatReturnDue.description: An advance VAT return and when it is due.

from.description: The first day of its period.

to.description: The last day of its period.
